The Linen Cap (reel)

Source: Craobh Rua - “If Ida Been Here, Ida Been There”
Transcription: g.m.p.

↳ Posted by gian marco on December 15th, 2003.

The Honorable Mrs. Moll’s

A version of this tune, in D, was recorded by the Scottish band Ossian, called The Honorable Mrs. Moll’s:

M:4/4
L:1/8
K:D
d2AG FDAF|EFGA BEec|d2AG FDAF|1 GBAF D/D/D D2|2 GBAF D/D/D DE|:
F/E/DA,D FDAD|EFGA BEAG|F/E/DA,D FDAF|GBAF D2DE|F/E/DA,D FDAD|EFGA BEAc|d2AG FDAF|GBAF D/D/D D2||

The tune appears by this name in the Athole Collection, but in A, if I remember rightly.

The following setting of The Linen Cap appears in O’Neills:

M: C|
L: 1/8
K: A
g|a2(ed) cdec|Bcde fBBg|a2(ed) cdec|dfed cAAg|a2(ed)cdec|Bcde fefg|agae
faec|dfed cA A||

dfed cA A|]
